correctness.rationale: The domain P_n and q-ary Fourier normalization are explicit. Pollak diagonal transversals algebraically give all forced balanced zeros and |P_n|. Nonbalanced cases for 1<=n<=5 are exhaustively checked by two independent exact computations: (i) cyclotomic tensor Fourier transform of every one of q^n characters; (ii) 2,6,20,70,252 sorted frequency representatives using distinct permutations of Catalan-sorted parking words and exact divisibility by Phi_q. The n=5 certificate supplies integer (A,B) coordinates of all 252 representatives and has exactly five nonbalanced zeros, of orbit sizes 120,60,60,60,60; rank is precisely 7776-1295-360=6121. Tests from packaged code passed; no approximation or unproven extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The classical parking-function indicator is a natural orbit transversal with a canonical Fourier recovery problem. The exact first-size threshold 1<=n<=4 versus n=5, together with 360 new null directions and the five rigid orbits, detects where information loss begins beyond the well-known diagonal symmetry. This structural finite cutoff is not a mere restatement of the parking-function count or of a known marginal statistic; the precise extra nullspace matters for invertibility and identifiability under counting convolution.
